invocations.moment: Intent stage — enrich the sparse feature description into confirmed scope/delivery/depth/UX/constraints/out-of-scope via adaptive probing
Intent stage — obligated existing feature-map read (FEATURES.md + territory entries) before story drafting
Story drafting — transform the feature into prioritized, independently testable user stories
Lockstep prototyping (UX-bearing ruled yes) — clickable low-fi prototype + Screens & Flows manifest
Requirements layer — FR-XXX, edge cases, SC-XXX, key entities (technology-agnostic)
invocations.sibling_disambiguation: Chose authoring-requirements (business FR/SC, spec stage) over authoring-technical-requirements (TR/NFR/constraints, plan stage) — specify does not author the technical layer.

invocations.moment: Derivation + filter after stories — derive proposed features, run the story filter, SC re-homing, stage the map delta, prepare the selection card
invocations.reload: Same body already loaded at the intent-stage map read; not re-counted in costs.

invocations.reload: Same body already loaded at lockstep prototyping; not re-counted in costs.

invocations.moment: Adversarial review of the drafted spec — gaps, feature-layer grade (10 checks), Screens & Flows walk (8 checks), verdict
invocations.sibling_disambiguation: Chose review-specifications (post-draft spec gap review) over review-brainstorm (decision-record cold review) and analysis-iterative (pre-spec enrichment).
